title: Beyond F1: Evaluating Coverage and Failure Recovery in AI Model Security Scanners
abstract: arXiv:2608.27424v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static scanners are increasingly used to identify executable or otherwise unsafe content in machine- learning artifacts, yet conventional evaluation metrics characterize only cases where a scanner yields a usable security judgment. We evaluate ModelScan, ModelAudit, and Fickling using a controlled, artifact-backed benchmark on a synthetic corpus of 170 Pickle and PyTorch focused artifacts across 145 specimen families, 135 of which have binary security ground truth and 10 of which are intentionally malformed without labels. We explicitly distinguish non-N/A coverage, analysis completion, definitive security decisions, non-security findings, and unsupported outcomes. On labeled families, ModelAudit produced definitive security decisions for all 135 families (100%), Fickling for 110 (81.5%), and ModelScan for 67 (49.6%). translated_title: 超越F1：评估AI模型安全扫描器的覆盖范围与故障恢复能力
translated_abstract: 摘要：静态扫描器越来越多地用于识别机器学习制品中的可执行或不安全内容，然而传统评估指标仅描述扫描器产生可用安全判断的情况。我们使用一个受控的、基于制品的基准，在包含170个Pickle和PyTorch重点制品的合成语料库上评估ModelScan、ModelAudit和Fickling，这些制品涵盖145个标本家族，其中135个具有二元安全基准真相，10个为故意构造的无标签畸形样本。我们明确区分非N/A覆盖范围、分析完成度、确定性安全决策、非安全发现及不支持的结果。在带标签的家族中，ModelAudit对所有135个家族（100%）产生了确定性安全决策，Fickling对110个（81.5%），ModelScan对67个（49.6%）。在做出确定性判断的条件下，ModelScan达到了100%的精确率、召回率和F1值。Fickling未识别出任何安全发现。
tldr: 本研究提出超越传统F1指标的评估框架，通过区分覆盖率和故障恢复能力，发现不同AI模型安全扫描器在确定性安全决策上存在显著差异，其中ModelAudit表现最优，而ModelScan在做出判断时精度最高。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an evaluation framework beyond traditional F1 metrics, distinguishing coverage and failure recovery, revealing significant differences in definitive security decisions among AI model security scanners, with ModelAudit performing best and ModelScan achieving highest precision when making judgments.
